title: 第16章 崩溃的白月光
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
唐梦辰此刻骂娘的心都有了。

    盗空宝库？？

    大夏万年基业，宝贝数之不尽，说盗就能盗空的？

    自己被演了。

    光天化日之下，洪烈胸口有伤在，自己跳进黄河也洗不清了。

    他虽然骄纵跋扈，但也只敢借着唐梦宫的名号去宝库取东西。

    至于攻打宝库…那是大夏禁地，给他一万个胆子他也不敢啊……

    唐梦宫的脸色差到了极点。

    她盯着洪烈，“此事涉及重大，你最好说出实情，否则后果不是你一个侍卫能承担的。”

    洪烈面色不变。

    “梦妃娘娘，属下刚说的都是实情，属下身上的伤口可做不了假。”

    唐梦宫深吸了口气，看向秦然凝声道：“云江仙，事情究竟如何，你比谁都清楚，唐梦辰断臂之事，绝不会就此罢休！”

    说完，便准备带着唐梦辰离开。

    秦然笑了。

    “爱妃，这里是皇宫，朕才是当家的，你对朕抛完狠话，还想把罪人带走？”

    “莫非…爱妃觉得自己的权力已凌驾在朕的皇权之上？还是说…北虞王府已经可以无视朕了？”

    唐梦宫动作一停，眼底闪过不可思议。

    “云江仙！你要拦我？”

    “你追了本小姐二十年，今日是要将所有情意全部斩断？”

    秦然漫不经心的摇摇头。

    “前几天朕已经说过了，那些情意都是假的。以前朕见你有几分姿色便垂怜你，但朕渐渐发现…这些宠幸，你唐梦宫不配拥有。”

    唐梦宫怔住了，脑海中嗡嗡作响。

    秦然的这番当众之言，如一记尖刀剜在了她的心头，前几日那未愈的心伤，再度被狠狠撕裂。

    “你！你说什么！”

    “云江仙，你再说一次！！！”

    唐梦宫声音颤抖，通红的眼眶中泛着杀意，粉拳已经捏红了。

    秦然环抱着双臂，脸上没有一丝波澜，甚至还透着一抹不耐烦。

    “唐梦宫，收起你高高在上的姿态，朕的爱有限，以后没你份儿了。”

    “朕腻了…”

    轰隆隆。

    这三个字成为了压倒唐梦宫的最后一根稻草。

    这番从小到大没听过的陌生言语，让她整个人彻底失神。

    心中的骄傲，这一刻轰然破裂……
content_en:
Tang Mengchen was ready to scold his mother now.

Stealing the treasure house??

Da Xia has a ten-thousand-year-old foundation, and there are countless treasures. Can you just steal it if you just say it?

I was played.

In broad daylight, Hong Lie had injuries on his chest, and he couldn't wash them away even if he jumped into the Yellow River.

Although he was arrogant and domineering, he only dared to use Tang Meng Palace's name to go to the treasure house to get things.

As for attacking the treasure house...it is a forbidden area in Daxia. Even if you give him ten thousand courages, he wouldn't dare...

Tang Menggong's expression was extremely bad.

She stared at Hong Lie, "This matter involves serious matters. You'd better tell the truth, otherwise the consequences will not be borne by a guard like you."

Hong Lie's expression did not change.

"Mother Mengfei, what I just said is the truth, and the wounds on my body cannot be faked."

Tang Menggong took a deep breath, looked at Qin Ran and said solemnly: "Xian Yunjiang, you know better than anyone what exactly happened. Tang Mengchen's broken arm will never let it go!"

After saying that, he was ready to leave with Tang Mengchen.

Kieran smiled.

"My dear concubine, this is the palace, and I am the one in charge. After you have said harsh words to me, you still want to take away the sinner?"

"Could it be that... my beloved concubine feels that her power is above my imperial power? Or... that the Beiyu Palace can already ignore me?"

Tang Menggong stopped moving, and his eyes flashed with disbelief.

"Yunjiangxian! Do you want to stop me?"

"You have been chasing this lady for twenty years, and today you are going to cut off all your feelings?"

Kieran shook his head casually.

"I have said a few days ago that those feelings are all fake. I used to pity you when I saw how beautiful you were, but I gradually discovered that... you, Tang Meng Palace, do not deserve these favors."

Tang Menggong was stunned, his mind buzzing.

Qin Ran's words in public were like a sharp knife stabbing into her heart, and the heartache that had not healed in the past few days was severely torn apart again.

"You! What did you say!"

"Yunjiangxian, say it again!!!"

Tang Menggong's voice was trembling, his red eyes were filled with murderous intent, and his pink fists were already pinched red.

Kieran crossed his arms, his face showed no trace of emotion, and even showed a hint of impatience.

"Tang Menggong, put away your condescending attitude. My love is limited, and I will no longer have your share."

"I'm tired of it..."

Rumble.

These three words became the last straw that broke Tang Menggong's mind.

These unfamiliar words, which she had never heard since she was a child, made her completely confused.

The pride in my heart suddenly shattered at this moment...
